sqlpipe v2.0 replaces `/v2/users` `name` with `first_name` and `last_name`. This breaking change affects clients that read `name`.

The CLI adds `--incremental`. The flag writes data that changed after the previous successful run. Incremental runs can reduce transfer time and storage use.

Parquet writes are 40% faster than v1.x writes. The improvement applies to the standard Parquet writer. sqlpipe v2.0 provides no compatibility layer for the removed `name` field.
